svgTool.title: SVG shape
svgTool.pickHint: Pick an SVG shape in the object list or the 3D view to change it, or add one from an .svg file: on the selected object, or as an object of its own when nothing is selected. Opening or dropping an .svg file adds one too.
svgTool.depthCutTip: How deep the shape cuts in
svgTool.depthTip: How far the shape stands out
svgTool.useSurfaceTip: The shape bends with the object's surface instead of standing flat on it
svgTool.undoHint: Undo brings the last shape back.
